headline: All four corrected NC translations approved as reference-only terminal outcomes on their exact bytes. One evidence-accuracy finding recorded against the watermark result, which does not change any verdict.

verdicts.sourceDigestBasis: recomputed from the installed official source bytes and equal to the recorded pin
verdicts.substantiveResult: Correct reference-only terminal outcome. The official source's own glyphs carry the informational notice, 'DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM FOR FILING' and 'USE THE ENGLISH VERSION'; official captions and layout are intact. The corrected package carries zero participant PDFs, zero canonical, boundary and negative artifacts, zero contact sheets, zero stale participant-artifact proofs and zero participant placements; participantFillable is false and the schema's artifactExpected and contactSheetExpected are both false, which is how this sidecar expresses generation not being allowed. All five withdrawn artifacts are represented by a current hash receipt that recomputes from source-record.json:artifactsWithdrawn, and none is present on disk or carried forward as a current artifact. The absence of a participant artifact is the correct legal and product outcome, and the English AOC-CR-287 and AOC-CR-288 filing trees are byte-unchanged.
verdicts.bindingResult: every recorded pin recomputed from current disk bytes and equal: source record, source receipt, overlay profile, census, classification, owner-disposition terminal state, withdrawal receipt, sidecar, terminal visual manifest and every source-raster digest

evidenceAccuracyFinding.reported: oversizedTextRuns: [] and watermarkPresent: false on every page
evidenceAccuracyFinding.independentlyMeasured: the source does carry a watermark on every page. On NC:aoc-cr-287-form-es page 1 there are 57 glyphs at 16pt or larger, up to 26.7pt against 7.0pt body text; ordering them along the diagonal reconstructs 'POR FAVOR LLENE LA VERSIÓN EN INGLÉS DE ESTE FORMULARIO'. Present on all pages of all four sources.
evidenceAccuracyFinding.why: the watermark is the court instructing the reader to use the English version, so it corroborates rather than contradicts the reference-only disposition. The misreport is an evidence-accuracy defect, not a defect in this family's terminal outcome, and rejecting a correctly absent participant artifact over it would be wrong.
